name: FilterBar
description: A toolbar for narrowing a list or table: an optional search, one menu per filter with checkable options, and the chosen values as removable chips with Clear all.
whenToUse: Above a table or list that people narrow by a few attributes, e.g. status and owner.
When several values of the same filter can apply at once.

whenNotToUse.text: To switch between a few fixed views.
For a single filter with two or three values.

anatomy.name: Search
anatomy.description: A SearchField at the start of the bar.

anatomy.name: Trigger
anatomy.description: Opens a filter’s menu; shows how many values are chosen.

anatomy.name: Menu
anatomy.description: Checkable options for one filter (a DropdownMenu).

anatomy.name: End
anatomy.description: A result count or sort menu at the end.

anatomy.name: Chips
anatomy.description: One removable Tag per chosen value, then Clear all.

values.meaning: Default. Chosen values show as removable chips under the bar.
Counts on the triggers only, for tight spaces.

states.name: Default
states.meaning: No values chosen for the filter.

states.name: Hover
states.meaning: The trigger responds to the pointer.

states.name: Focus
states.meaning: Shows keyboard focus on a trigger.

states.name: Open
states.meaning: The filter’s menu is open; the chevron flips.

states.name: Active
states.meaning: The filter has chosen values; tinted with a count.

behavior.text: Menus stay open while options are checked, so several values can be chosen at once.
Pass value and onValueChange to control the filters (e.g. to sync with the URL), or defaultValue.
Each chip removes its value; Clear all removes every value.
The bar wraps; search takes the first row.

content: Chips read "Filter: value" so they make sense on their own.
Show the number of results in end so people see the effect.

guidelines.do: Show the result count next to the filters.
guidelines.dont: Leave people guessing whether a filter changed anything.
guidelines.why: Immediate feedback confirms the filter applied.

guidelines.do: Keep to three to five filters.
guidelines.dont: Put every column of the table in the bar.
guidelines.why: Too many triggers wrap into a wall of buttons.

guidelines.do: Keep chips on when filters can be combined.
guidelines.dont: Hide what is filtered in narrow layouts without a count.
guidelines.why: People forget active filters and think data is missing.

accessibility.role: toolbar, named by label; each filter is a menu button with checkbox items.

keyboard.action: Moves between search, triggers, chips and Clear all.
Move between options in the menu.
Closes the menu and returns focus to its trigger.

aria.when: On each trigger, set by the menu.

accessibility.focus: Triggers show a focus ring; focus returns to the trigger when its menu closes.

wcag.how: Counts are announced with the trigger name, e.g. "Status, 2 selected".
Menus and chips work fully from the keyboard.

notes: Active filters are shown by count and chips, not only by tint.

examples.title: Invoice filters
examples.description: Search, two filters and a result count.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.description: Keeps filters in state, e.g. to sync them with the URL.
examples.code:
import { FilterBar } from '@ds/react';

<FilterBar label="Filter" filters={filters} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} />

examples.title: Without chips
examples.code:
import { FilterBar } from '@ds/react';

<FilterBar label="Filter" filters={filters} showChips={false} />

components.name: FilterBar
components.description:
A toolbar for narrowing a list or table: an optional search, one menu per filter with
checkable options, and the chosen values as removable chips.

search.description: Content at the start of the bar, usually a SearchField.

end.description: Content at the end, e.g. a result count or a sort menu.

showChips.description: Shows the chosen values as removable chips under the bar. Default true.

clearLabel.description: Words for the clear button. Default "Clear all".

selectedLabel.description: Spoken name of a trigger with chosen values. Default "{filter}, {count} selected".

removeLabel.description: Words for a chip's remove button. Default "Remove {filter}: {option}".

--filter-bar-trigger-height.description: Height of medium (default) buttons, fields and selects.

--filter-bar-trigger-padding-x.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--filter-bar-trigger-gap.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--filter-bar-trigger-default-border-colo.description: Outline of text fields, selects and comboboxes; the lightest gray with 3:1 contrast.

--filter-bar-trigger-hover-bg-color.description: App background behind cards and panels.

--filter-bar-trigger-active-bg-color.description: Subtle tinted background for a tone, e.g. alerts, selected items, badges.

--filter-bar-trigger-active-border-color.description: Regular tone outline, e.g. alert borders.

--filter-bar-trigger-active-text-color.description: Main tone-colored text on light or tinted backgrounds: titles, active items.

--filter-bar-trigger-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--filter-bar-trigger-icon-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--filter-bar-duration.description: Small state changes: hover, press, toggle.

--filter-bar-easing.description: Moving between two states on screen.

--filter-bar-count-padding-x.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--filter-bar-count-bg-color.description: Fill of filled buttons; the accent in light mode, a darker step in dark mode.

--filter-bar-count-text-color.description: Text and icons on the matching strong fill (light text in dark mode).

--filter-bar-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

--filter-bar-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

--filter-bar-focus-ring-color.description: Focus ring color; follows the brand accent.

--filter-bar-trigger-border-radius.description: Corner radius steps in px (see --radius-* in themes/radius.css).
